text:
sylvia: Quick post-call note: vendor pushed a driver patch that changes runtime flags. We're tracking impact on marketplace images and SI certs. Need to decide announce vs delay.
mark: what's the delta? Are we talking functional change or just perf knobs?
tony: vendor note: driver v2.1 toggles a new memory allocator by default. Functional at runtime; could require rebuilds for Gaudi images. Perf impact unknown until can run full perf sweep.
anya: marketplace requirement: final image + driver hash 10 calendar days before public listing. If driver changes, that moves our timeline. Also marketing embargo lead = 8 business days.
vendor-bot: Vendor bulletin: driver v2.1 released to partners (RC). Expected GA 2024-08-05 if tests pass. (link: https://vendor.example/drivers/2.1)
sylvia: practical asks:
- SI rebuild window for Gaudi & MI300 (TONY)
- marketplace SKU freeze decision (MARK)
- legal/marketing embargo constraints (ANYA)
mark: if GA is 2024-08-05, marketplace publish earliest is 2024-08-15 (we need 10 calendar days + e2e). That conflicts with our product roadmap which aimed for 2024-08-10.
tony: SI ops: estimate 48-72h per integrator to rebuild and cert if allocator changes. Need to reserve dry-run lanes next Mon/Tue. Will ping integrator leads.
anya: marketing: with 8bd embargo lead we'll need copy by 2024-08-05 if we want 2024-08-15 announce. Legal-bot: attach the clause we need re: vendor microcode and driver dependencies.
legal-bot: Clause draft: "Performance and availability subject to vendor-provided driver/firmware final validation. Redwood disclaims forward-looking benchmark projections until vendor GA confirmed."
sylvia: fallback mapping: if H100 misses GA, route latency-critical production traffic to H200 or B200 quantized variants. Example route rule to create: `route.fallback.set('h100', ['h200-prod','b200-q8']) when microcode_unverified=true`
mark: agree. Also propose soft-launch to partners on 2024-08-06 with pinned-hash images for early access. Public announce only after vendor signs GA.
tony: integrator note: Gaudi ABI change in allocator requires container base image bump. We'll document steps and provide automated CI job to rebuild images. Target: two-day automated rebuild once RC confirmed.
anya: marketing asks for one paragraph fallback messaging: "Rolling launch: initial partner-only access; public availability pending vendor driver GA." I'll draft.
vendor-bot: FYI: H100 microcode validation job still running; ETA update expected 48h. MI300 APAC cert unchanged.
sylvia: action items and owners:
- tony: schedule SI rebuild lanes + CI job (due 2024-07-20)
- mark: prepare marketplace soft-launch plan and pinned hashes (due 2024-07-21)
- anya: draft fallback marketing copy + embargo calendar (due 2024-07-21)
- sylvia: coordinate vendor confirmation and update this thread (ongoing)
mark: if vendor GA slips beyond 2024-08-07 we cancel public announce and keep partner-only listing. Anyone object?
tony: no objection. We need to ensure Dedicated pool capacity reassignments are possible on short notice. I'll loop infra.
sylvia: noted. I'll add a risk line for EU private deploy data residency delaying cert by ~3 business days.
anya: will include that in the marketing calendar.
vendor-bot: Next vendor update scheduled 2024-07-18 16:00 UTC.
sylvia: ok team. I'll update the partners drive timeline and ping integrator leads after vendor update. Thanks. :thumbsup:
